scenes.title: AI Is Rewriting Software Development
scenes.subtitle: How artificial intelligence is transforming how we build software in 2026
scenes.narration: Artificial intelligence is fundamentally reshaping how software is built, tested, and deployed in 2026.

scenes.title: Developer Adoption
scenes.stat_label: of developers now use AI tools regularly
scenes.description: Up from 44% in 2023 — crossing the mainstream threshold in just three years. Source: JetBrains 2025 Ecosystem Survey
scenes.narration: Eighty-five percent of professional developers now use AI tools regularly, up from just 44 percent in 2023.

scenes.title: AI-Generated Code
scenes.stat_label: of all new code is AI-assisted
scenes.description: Projected to reach 60% by end of 2026. GitHub Copilot alone has 20 million users across 90% of Fortune 100 companies.
scenes.narration: Nearly half of all new code is now AI-assisted, projected to reach 60 percent by the end of 2026.

scenes.title: How Coding Is Changing
items: Writing code feels more like editing than typing from scratch
Junior devs reach productivity milestones faster with AI guidance
Senior devs use AI mainly for refactoring and code review
Developers save 3.6 hours per week on average
Code documentation quality improves with AI support
scenes.narration: Writing code now feels more like editing than typing from scratch, with developers saving an average of 3.6 hours per week.

scenes.title: AI Coding Tools Market
scenes.narration: The AI coding tools market reached 7.37 billion dollars in 2025, with GitHub Copilot holding 42 percent enterprise share.

scenes.title: Before AI vs With AI
scenes.narration: AI absorbs the friction of software development — automating boilerplate, tests, and documentation so teams focus on architecture.

scenes.title: Productivity Impact
scenes.description: GitHub study of 4,800 developers. AI users merge 60% more pull requests. But gains concentrate on well-defined repetitive tasks.
scenes.narration: A study of 4,800 developers found tasks completed 55 percent faster with AI assistance, with users merging 60 percent more pull requests.

scenes.title: The Security Reality
scenes.description: 45% of AI-generated code samples fail security tests. Human review is still essential — AI writes fast, but oversight matters.
scenes.narration: AI-generated code contains 2.74 times more vulnerabilities than human-written code. Human oversight remains essential.

scenes.title: The Verdict
scenes.quote: AI is not replacing developers. It is absorbing friction.
scenes.attribution: Teams that embrace AI thoughtfully build better software and healthier teams
scenes.narration: The future of development is not human versus machine. It is human supported by machine.

scenes.title: Human + Machine
scenes.subtitle: Shifting from writing code to designing systems
scenes.narration: AI is shifting the developer role from writing code to designing systems. The question isn't if you'll use AI, but how deeply.
